Synopsis:
    Asian equities fell on yen strength and mixed data, with Nikkei down 1.7% and MSCI Asia-Pac ex-Japan off 0.5%. The yen surged ~1% to 152.89 on carry-trade unwinding and BOJ tightening expectations, supported by strong Japanese wage growth (+2.4% YoY) and upward GDP revision. Oil jumped 1.4% to $98.34/bbl on US-Iran escalation. US 10Y Treasury yields edged up to 4.798%. Markets price ~60% probability of a 25bps Fed hike at the Sep 16 meeting. Copper hit an all-time high of $14,597/ton; gold steady at $4,404. Bitcoin slid 1%.
